baseline.note: January-first refugee birthday and Wednesday market day is a resonant, earned reveal; ending slightly too neat and sentimental.

storyscope.note: Sharp, funny voice; survey-receipt twist cleverly deflates theories, granddaughter jar adds grace. Twist slightly undercuts emotional payoff.

writing-skill.note: NICU weekly birthdays, real suspense over the missed week, restrained voice, perfect closing line. Most moving and controlled.

merged.note: Charming ensemble and video-call granddaughter reveal, but baggy, number-list device thin, payoff lighter than its setup.
